steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You saw it, Morgan?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The guards at the warehouse were so nervous that they didn't even see me coming.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Alright, alright, you win today. Take your jerky.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Ha, knew you'd be cross. Next time you can come with, and loser has to keep guard.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: ...They're staring at us.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What are you stari—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What's this about...? Get outta the way, already. I need a drink from the kitchen. Thirsty after all that work.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You shouldn't have done that.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You mean lure away the Sarkaz patrol, giving your people a chance to escape the warehouse?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Funny way to say 'thank you'? Or did I hear you wrong?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Our comrades in Sudean are grateful, and so are we. The mission went well. But why did you have to burn the warehouse?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: It belonged to a Victorian merchant, not the Sarkaz! The Sarkaz were just occupying it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Ha. Those fat cats are as cowardly as they are greedy. They want to help the Sarkaz, I'm happy to make them suffer for it.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You do understand that you're just driving them into the arms of the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Even better. More than just warehouses to burn for those traitors.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: That's gangster talk, not the way of the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Do you still insist on working with these people, Lady Isabelle?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: My name is Dagda here.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: It's just, Lady Isa—Dagda. When Lady Allerdale introduced you and Her Highness to us, we thought...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege told you on day one that it was the Glasgow Gang working with the Corps, not Her Highness Alexandrina and the Knight of the Tower.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Do you really want to see a hoodlum lead us, even take the throne?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What shit-for-brains gives you the right to say that about Vina?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Sword back in its place, Morgan! We're on their ground!

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Many of us would rather follow you and Cumberland...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Stuff it! I-I mean, you've said your piece. As long as we still stand together, you should not speak ill of our fellows.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Sorry, I spoke out of turn.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You shouldn't have stopped me.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And let you make a mess for Vina to clean up? Not to mention the bunny and the Doctor from Rhodes Island. Next time, think about your company before you lose your head.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ha... never thought the day would come that you'd be the one talking to me about losing my head.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Gotta change, and adapt to the environment. Look how Dagda is doing.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Don't say that, it feels weird.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You think I wanna congratulate you? Living your way doesn't feel too nice.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But there's one thing the past couple days've taught me, Morgan. We have to adapt to keep up with Vina.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Here, your jerky. Neither of us won the day.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Keep it. I've got no appetite.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I've been thinking, Hannah... is this the kind of life that Vina wants? Since when did nobles and merchants give her the respect she deserves?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You're not thinking from the right angle.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: They'll realize Vina is a good leader. And the respect Vina gets, she would've earned herself.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Ah, Lady Allerdale! Finally!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sorry, I've been busy.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I heard you were looking for a buyer for the Steam Armor?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...The news reached you quickly.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Only rumors, only rumors. A friend mentioned that a suit of Steam Armor from Londinium might appear on the market.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: But the transaction fell through at the last minute.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I would not recommend that you sell something so valuable too easily. It's hard to get a good price under current market conditions.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Thank you for the advice. I'm just trying to do something useful with what little assets my family has left.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I understand. What little money we have means nothing to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Has the banquet not yet started? There's no need to wait for me.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: We can't have that now. You've been the pillar of Central Londinium for ages. It's all thanks to you that we're alive today.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: How is one even supposed to negotiate with a bunch of lunatics who don't care about money?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You flatter me, sir. I'm just a nobody who spoke up a few times at the unjust treatment that those like you have received.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Now, now, don't say that. House Cumberland will undoubtedly rise again under your leadership!

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: Yes, the past is the past now.

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: When Londinium knows peace again—not to say that she's not at peace right now, of course!

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: In any case, House Cumberland will have our gratitude.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Lt. Colonel Lettou is here!

steps.name: Slimy Noble & Astute Noble
steps.text: We salute you!

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: It's an honor, Lt. Colonel. You have not graced us with your presence for many nights.

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: We are most grateful for your efforts to keep the peace!

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: I've come into a few bottles of excellent wine.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: They may not have been so impressive in the old days, but in times like these they are a rarity. I'll have my butler bring them to your residence.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: There will be no more banquets, from this day forth.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: The Military Commission will be interviewing you soon. Good luck.

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Slimy Noble
steps.text: Wait, no! What do you mean?

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: Lt. Colonel Lettou! Lt. Colonel Lettou!

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: Lady Allerdale, you must speak to Lt. Colonel Lettou! This is serious! P-People will die!

steps.name: Astute Noble
steps.text: Lt. Colonel! Please don't go!

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Miss, this is...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The Sarkaz have been biding their time. They let these fools wallow in luxury in order to keep the dukes from coming together.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: There is nothing any given duke would like more than to become the master of Victoria.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: At the center of Victorian high society is Londinium, and whomever makes an enemy of Londinium nobility makes an enemy of the entire state.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Such an offense against Victoria would have forced the dukes to put aside their individual interests and join forces to march on Londinium.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But the Sarkaz don't care anymore.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: They've achieved their goal.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Some think what befell Londinium the past few years a disaster. But now—

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: War has truly come.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: What about us, then?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Could you talk to Lt. Colonel Lettou, as the nobles suggested? You might...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: They called me 'pillar'. But whom amongst them set foot in Cumberland Manor before the Sarkaz took control of Londinium?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Which of the Duke's true friends participated in these pretentious banquets?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm simply a figurehead for nobles who lack chips on their side, or those who are trying to protect themselves.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: They flocked to the Cumberland banner, so Cumberland may take the fall for them.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: So what you mean is...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Let's go, Ailshie. Inform our Self-Salvation Corps and Rhodes Islander friends to evacuate the ducal manor immediately. It is no longer safe.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We'll take one last look at our ancestral home.

steps.name: Noble?
steps.text: Allerdale.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You are...

steps.name: Noble?
steps.text: A letter from the duke.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: A few days in Auchterigg, then Highbury. Look at all those factories and houses packed tight together. Never seen a place so cramped.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Can we go back to Central Londinium after this mission, Captain?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: And do what? I don't know what Manfred was thinking, hiring kids like you who've barely taken a life before...

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I'm not a kid! I did a lot of jobs back in Columbia with Grimm, when he was still around!

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Grimm, eh...? I have babysit now because he got himself killed in Sudean. I should've taken his head and nabbed the bounty beforehand.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Er... weren't you friends?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: It's not my job to teach you how to be a mercenary, kid. But it is yours to read the map. Where do we go next?

spans.text: It's not my job to teach you how to be a mercenary, kid. But it
yours to read the map. Where do we go next?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Munitions Factory No. 11 is just ahead.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: General Manfred gave us a pretty long list... these are all older workers who know something, right? Just take them somewhere with no witnesses and kill them?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: I would kill everyone in the factory, if it were up to me.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: All that crap about killing only the ones who know anything... does he have any idea how much trouble that is?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Well, he's the boss.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Whatever. Put away the list and let's go.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Feist!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Patto.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: It's been a year. I missed you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry, I should have tried to send word.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Never mind that. I'm so glad to see you. For the past year, I've been telling everyone that you'd definitely come back alive.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Remember that vent over there? There's a bit of a platform outside the other end of it.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: A few years ago, you said you would jump off it and onto the factory next door.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: We were scared out of our minds. It was what, more than thirty meters off the ground? Fall, and you'd be dead for sure.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But you dared to jump. And then... Tommy jumped, Day jumped, and in the end I jumped too.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Whenever they ask me if I think you're dead, I tell them to look up at the vent.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha... we weren't afraid of anything, were we?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: So these are your Self-Salvation Corps friends?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Looks well-read to me.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I heard there were all kinds in the Corps. Guess the rumors are true.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Doctor is definitely well-read.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: You have partners?

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: It's sounding more and more like the real deal, isn't it?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: So, why have you come back? Anything I can help with?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Patto!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Ca—

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Get back to work.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But Feist is back, isn't he? He's not going anywhere?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Don't you worry about him right now. As for your friend, we should talk somewhere else.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Don't blame Catherine, Feist.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: She's been protecting us from the Sarkaz for the past year. It's thanks to her that we haven't lost anybody.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: There was one time when things got really bad, and she called on the leader of the Defense Forces to mediate.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: But the Sarkaz have been putting more pressure on us, on Catherine.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know, Patto.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I don't blame Granny one bit.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: When I joined the Corps and truly understood what I was facing...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I knew what a difficult decision Granny had to make.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Alright, talk. What did you come back for?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're looking for something.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Something?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes. A hidden Sarkaz supply line that's fueling their mad war.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're certain the line ends here in the industrial district.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We need to find it.

options: Feist says no one knows the district better.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No one knows the district better than you, Granny. I'm sure you can help.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That's why I came to you.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Flattering me won't do you any good.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Yes, we won't cause any trouble for the factory.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Why do you think I would help you?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Maybe I already told Patto to call the Sarkaz mercenaries.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If that's the case... I'll have to flee with the others.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Tell me, how many died in that incident you caused in Sudean?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Do you remember their names? Their faces? Do you remember what they looked like when they died? Their last words?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Don't rush your answer, Feist. And don't try to bluff your way through it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I don't know what this 'Doctor' of yours thinks, but I know you. You think you're smart, but being smart isn't enough to fool death.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Catherine! A bunch of Sarkaz just showed up at the door...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor, we need to get out of here—

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: They say Lt. Colonel Lettou, a Defense Force officer, wants to see you. You're to be escorted.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: George, watch these two and make sure they stay put.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Care for a smoke?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Don't bother trying to butter me up.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Lt. Colonel Lettou wants to see me?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We've been meeting our targets. Nothing for him to worry about.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Whatever. He wants to see you. Come with us.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Give me a minute. I have something to take care of first.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: We're not asking, old bag.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I have to put someone in charge. This is very sudden, after all.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: We can wait a little bit... can't we?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: (Whisper) I don't think the General wants a scene.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Captain
steps.text: Ugh. You have ten minutes.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Good enough.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny, why are they looking for you?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: None of your business.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Shut up and come with me.
